oids.name: vpwrIdentManufacturer
oids.description: The name of the DC Power manufacturer.

oids.name: vpwrIdentModel
oids.description: The DC Power Model designation.

oids.name: vpwrIdentControllerVersion
oids.description: The hardware/firmware version(s). This variable may or may not have the same value as vpwrIdentAgentSoftwareVersion.

oids.name: vpwrIdentAgentSoftwareVersion
oids.description: The SNMP agent software version. This variable may or may not have the same value as vpwrIdentControllerVersion.

oids.name: vpwrIdentName
oids.description: A string identifying the system. This object should be set by the administrator.

oids.name: vpwrShelfIndex
oids.description: Identifies shelf number that this module belongs to. The possible values are 1 through 16 limited by vpwrSystemShelfCapacity.

oids.name: vpwrModuleIndex
oids.description: This object identifies the module by its position in the shelf. Module numbering is left to right starting with module 1. So, the module in the first slot has an index of 1, the next module is 2 an...

oids.name: vpwrModuleOID
oids.description: It indicates the type of the module by specifiying its OID

oids.name: vpwrModuleCurrent
oids.description: The meaning of this object depends upon the module type which is indicated by vpwrModuleOID as follows - Current for Rectifier module in centiamps. - Not Applicable for LVD module

oids.name: vpwrModuleOperStatus
oids.description: This object indicates current over all status of the module.

oids.name: vpwrModuleCapacity
oids.description: The meaning of this object depends upon the module type which is indicated by vpwrModuleOID as follows - Capacity for Rectifier module. - Not Applicable for LVD module

oids.name: vpwrSystemTempCompensation
oids.description: This parameter enables/disables temperature compensation.

oids.name: vpwrSystemTempCompStartTemperature
oids.description: The temperature at which temperature compensation becomes active.

oids.name: vpwrSystemTempCompStopVoltage
oids.description: When temperature compensation is active, vpwrSystemTempCompStopVoltage is the limit to which float voltage will be reduced. For example, to set this voltage to 51.75 volts enter a value of 5175.

oids.name: vpwrSystemTempCompensationSlope
oids.description: The rate at which float voltage is changed, within the specified limits, when temperature compensation is active.

oids.name: vpwrSystemThermalSenseType
oids.description: This parameter selects the temperature sensing point for temperature compensation (in)activation.

oids.name: vpwrSystemHVAlarmSetpoint
oids.description: System High voltage alarm voltage setting.

oids.name: vpwrSystemBDAlarmSetpoint
oids.description: System Battery Discharge voltage setting.

oids.name: vpwrSystemInternalTempLThreshold
oids.description: Temperature value at which temperature compensation inactive (clear) trap would be sent if temperature compensation was active when this value is reached.

oids.name: vpwrSystemInternalTempUThreshold
oids.description: Temperature value at which temperature compensation active (set) trap would be sent.

oids.name: vpwrSystemShelfCapacity
oids.description: It describes the maximum number of shelves that can/are controlled by the controller. Each shelf is uniquely numbered in the range from 1 to vpwrShelfCapacity.

oids.name: vpwrSystemVoltage
oids.description: The current system voltage.

oids.name: vpwrSystemCurrent
oids.description: The current system current.

oids.name: vpwrSystemControllerState
oids.description: Current System state as shown on the enhanced display.

oids.name: vpwrSystemInternalTemperature
oids.description: The current controller internal temperature.

oids.name: vpwrSystemTempCompensationState
oids.description: Active or Inactive. Applicable only if temperature compensation is enabled. This means that the controller is temperature compensating the float voltage.

oids.name: vpwrSystemType
oids.description: This parameter describes the type of the system being managed. This object is set by Eltek Valere Inc.

oids.name: vpwrSystemCumulativeUpTime
oids.description: This parameter describes the cumulative runtime in seconds of the Eltek Valere controller.

oids.name: vpwrSystemBatteryRemainingTime
oids.description: This parameter describes the remaining battery capacity based upon installed battery capacity and plant load. This number would change as the SOC parameters of the batteries changes.

oids.description: Indicates a Major Alarm exists on the system.

oids.name: vpwrSystemAlarmMinor
oids.description: Indicates a Minor Alarm exists on the system.

oids.name: vpwrSystemACFailAlarm
oids.description: One or more rectifiers have reported AC failure. If system is configured to report rectifier communication failure as AC fail this alarm will report.

oids.name: vpwrSystemHighVoltageWarningAlarm
oids.description: System has exceeded High Voltage Warning Setpoint. Check for high voltage on system bus.

oids.name: vpwrSystemHighVoltageShutdownAlarm
oids.description: One or more rectifiers have shut down due to high voltage present on output. Check bus voltage and reseat rectifiers that have indicated this problem.

oids.name: vpwrSystemBatteryonDischargeAlarm
oids.description: System voltage has currently dropped below the alarm setpoint. This may be due to battery testing or AC failure.

oids.name: vpwrSystemLowVoltageWarningAlarm
oids.description: System Voltage has dropped below setpoint for Low Voltage Alarm. This may occur during battery testing or AC failure

oids.name: vpwrSystemLVDOpenAlarm
oids.description: One or more contactors have opened. This occurs normally during system power on. If it occurs during operation this may indicate system is operating below LVD disconnect voltage.

oids.name: vpwrSystemDistributionAlarm
oids.description: One or more distribution alarm inputs are reporting an error condition. Check source of alarm and correct issue.

oids.name: vpwrSystemAuxiliaryAlarm
oids.description: One or more Auxliary alarm inputs are reporting an error condition. Check source of alarm and correct issue.

oids.name: vpwrSystemRedundantCapAlarm
oids.description: The system load has exceeded the requirements for redundancy. This may be a temporary system overload condition or caused by a rectifier alarm.

oids.name: vpwrSystemRectIShareAlarm
oids.description: One or more rectifiers are reporting a mismatch in current. This may be due to mismatched rectifier models or one or more rectifiers not current sharing

oids.name: vpwrSystemThermRAAlarm
oids.description: Thermal Runaway has occurred on system. Check temperature inputs.

oids.name: vpwrSystemBDTAlarm
oids.description: System has entered Battery Discharge Test mode

oids.name: vpwrSystemRectUVAlarm
oids.description: Rectifier output has dropped 1V below Low Voltage Alarm setpoint

oids.name: vpwrSystemTempProbeAlarm
oids.description: Temp probe input missing or failed

oids.name: vpwrSystemRngrCommAlarm
oids.description: Ringer Module has stopped communicating with Controller.

oids.name: vpwrSystemDistPMCommAlarm
oids.description: One or more distribution alarm modules, TRIOs, or PM modules has stopped communicating with Controller.

oids.name: vpwrSystemRectILimitAlarm
oids.description: Rectifier has reached current limit setpoint.

oids.name: vpwrSystemUnmappedI2CCANAlarm

oids.name: vpwrSystemConfigErrAlarm
